findings.issue: frontmatter `verify: []` but the task body has a substantive `### Smoke` subsection with real executable checks (`grep -n "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" client/src/pages/Panel.jsx`, and a `git diff`/`git log` check on deepseek.go). Per feature-execution's Phase 3 wave-transition step ('If task had Smoke/User verification steps — confirm teammate reported verification results'), the orchestrator is forbidden from reading full task content during execution and relies solely on the frontmatter `verify` field to know whether to expect and confirm verification results. With `verify: []`, the orchestrator will not know to confirm this task's smoke checks were run and reported, even though the task body clearly requires them. Compare Task 2, which has `verify: [smoke]` and a matching `### Smoke` subsection with real content — the established pattern in this feature's own sibling tasks.
findings.fix: Set frontmatter `verify: [smoke]` on Task 7 to match the real `### Smoke` content in its Verification Steps section.

findings.issue: frontmatter `verify: []` but the task body has a substantive `### User` subsection ('Ask the user to confirm the manual checklist... report the user's confirmation (or lack of it) verbatim, and treat an unconfirmed checklist as a QA fail') and an Acceptance Criteria item explicitly requiring user confirmation ('User confirms the manual "How to Verify" checklist... was walked through'). This user-confirmation step is central to this QA task's entire purpose — the feature is explicitly not deploy-ready without it. Per feature-execution's Phase 3 ('If task had Smoke/User verification steps — confirm teammate reported verification results'), the orchestrator only reads task frontmatter during execution (reading full task content is a forbidden action for the lead), so `verify: []` means the orchestrator has no signal to confirm this critical user-verification step was actually reported before marking the task/wave done. Compare Task 1, which has `verify: [user]` and a matching `### User` subsection.
findings.fix: Set frontmatter `verify: [user]` on Task 9 to match the real `### User` content in its Verification Steps section (the `### Smoke` subsection explicitly states 'No agent-executable smoke checks', so `smoke` should not be added).
